aggregation: Median of the three run medians; reduction=(before-after)/before*100. P99 columns are maximum run p99, not pooled percentiles.
limitations: Baseline runs precede optimized runs; OS scheduling, frequency, caches and other processes uncontrolled. No statistical confidence interval or universal overhead claim.
Synthetic integer model, zero effects, 8-byte/1-KiB/4-KiB complete state. Fixture setup and input/snapshot capture/admission excluded. No actual engine/network/rendering workload.

Prefix profiles start at first retained input; suffix profiles retain the full 512-entry buffer and replay its final N ticks. Suffix profiles additionally use CapturedSnapshot restore integrity checking.
One-tick replay chunks execute consecutively, measuring total computation rather than time spread across actual frames.
Exact record and payload digest checks retained. Contiguous arrays use slot hints; other layouts can still require linear fallback.
All 391 separately instrumented optimized operations recorded zero Rust System allocations/reallocations/requested bytes; consumer callbacks may allocate.
